claims.claim: The central bridge uses workflow_run.completed delivery, and all four affected source workflows export one selector artifact named for github.run_attempt.

Pointers contain only version, source kind and numeric GitHub selectors. The bridge independently fetches and validates workflow identity, source repository, parent Issue, source identity, trusted bot, title and bounded body grammar before classification.
The projector implements the required ingress, review, dispatch-rejection and terminal-attention families while preserving NO_WAKE for ordinary accepted, PASS, replayed and in-progress receipts.
Artifact provenance, attempt, size, archive contents and exact pointer schema are checked. Rejected handoffs project only WAKE_SOURCE_HANDOFF_FAILURE with bounded workflow-run selectors.
Publication completion projects PUBLICATION_WORKFLOW_COMPLETED; failed self-hosted execution projects PRE_AIOS_OPERATIONAL_FAILURE; successful self-hosted execution remains NO_WAKE.

Source-object event IDs exclude workflow attempts. Posting uses event-ID concurrency and exact PR #1200 replay detection. Wake bodies contain only bounded bell fields and mandatory fresh Brain Sync, and the bridge has no Issue/comment triggers.
Source lifecycle operations and permissions are preserved apart from selector exports. The implementation adds no secret, launcher, polling, relay, persistent state store or lifecycle authority.

Added focused regressions covering suppressed-event handoff topology, provenance, attempt binding, malformed and substituted inputs, workflow identity, permissions, replay and authorized-file scope. The committed candidate changes only the 13 permitted files.
